```{ojs}
import {Inputs} from "@observablehq/inputs";
import {Plot} from "@observablehq/plot";
```

### Plan settings

```{ojs}
viewof freq = Inputs.select(["Daily","Weekly","Monthly"], {
  label: "Contribution frequency",
  value: "Daily"
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof amount = Inputs.number({label: "Amount per period (UGX)", value: 3000, step: 100, min: 100})
```

```{ojs}
viewof pct = Inputs.range([1,100], {label: "% of periods saved (Annualy) ", value: 60, step:1})
```

```{ojs}
viewof yrs = Inputs.range([1,10], {label: "Projection horizon (years)", value: 5, step:1})
```

```{ojs}
viewof rate = Inputs.number({label: "Annual interest rate (%)", value: 4.9, step:0.1, min:0})
```

---

### Projection summary

```{ojs}

md`If you save **${amount.toLocaleString()} UGX**  **${freq}**, for **${pct}%** of the year, over **${yrs} years**, at an annual interest rate of **${rate}%**, then:`
```

### Data & calculations

```{ojs}
periodsPerYear = ({Daily:365, Weekly:52, Monthly:12})[freq]
```

```{ojs}
proj = {
  const amt = Number(amount);
  const pctNum = Number(pct);
  const yrsNum = Number(yrs);
  const totalPeriods = yrsNum * periodsPerYear;
  const n = Math.round(pctNum/100 * periodsPerYear);
  const r = (1 + Number(rate)/100) ** (1/periodsPerYear) - 1;
  const contribVec = Array.from({length: totalPeriods}, (_, i) =>
    (i % periodsPerYear < n ? amt : 0)
  );
  const growth = Array.from({length: totalPeriods}, (_, i) =>
    (1 + r) ** (totalPeriods - i)
  );
  const fvEach = contribVec.map((c, i) => c * growth[i]);
  const byYear = Array.from({length: yrsNum}, (_, y) => {
    const start = y * periodsPerYear;
    const end = start + periodsPerYear;
    return fvEach.slice(start, end).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  });
  const cumFV = byYear.reduce((acc, v) => { acc.push((acc.at(-1) || 0) + v); return acc; }, []);
  const yearlyContrib = amt * n;
  const cumContrib = Array.from({length: yrsNum}, (_, y) => yearlyContrib * (y + 1));
  return cumContrib.map((c, i) => ({Year: i+1, Contributed: c, Future_Value: cumFV[i]}));
}
```

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(proj, {
  columns:["Year","Contributed","Future_Value"],
  format:{
    Contributed: v => v.toLocaleString(),
    Future_Value: v => v.toLocaleString(undefined,{maximumFractionDigits:0})
  }
})
```

### Growth chart

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  y: {label: ""},
  x: {label: "Year"},
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(proj, {x: "Year", y: "Future_Value", fill: "#ffcb05"}),
    Plot.text(proj, {
      x: "Year",
      y: "Future_Value",
      text: d => (d.Future_Value / 1e6).toFixed(2) + " M",
      dy: -6,
      textAnchor: "middle",
      fontSize: 12,
      fill: "black"
    })
  ]
})
```
